note: Alfalfa County parcel polygons are not published as a public queryable service. The county assessor's parcel search links to an interactive vendor map at oklmrecords.com/alfalfa/map whose parcel overlay source is not exposed as any REST endpoint; the county maps page links only static JPG/PDF files. The statewide OK Maps parcel layer is view-only (WMS, not for download). Regrid's nationwide parcel service requires a token. The county's ArcGIS group service (Alfalfa_gdb) holds districts, hydrology and roads, with no parcels. Commercial sources are paid.
